title: Exact localization of the normalized open compositor
statement: For abelian categories A, B, C with chosen unbounded derived categories [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], let F:A→B, G:B→C, H:A→C and P:B→A, Q:C→B, T:C→A be additive exact functors with specified adjunctions a:F⊣P, b:G⊣Q and c:H⊣T [def-weil-exact-derived-adjunction]. For an isomorphism e:Q⋙P≅T, let ν:F⋙G≅H be its canonical left-adjoint composition comparison. The left-adjoint composition comparison for the three exact localized adjunctions, taken at the standard exact localization of e, equals the inverse standard exact-functor composition isomorphism followed by the exact localization of ν.

source.place: Tag 015F, exact localization of adjunction units and counits; Stacks sites-cohomology.tex Tag 07A7, unit-square-counit convention.

proof.text: The ordinary left-adjoint compositor is characterized by its unit equation. Apply that equation degreewise to cochain complexes.

Use normalized adjunction composition and uniqueness [lem-pur-normalized-adjunction-composition] with the exact-functor factorization isomorphisms. The unit equation identifies the localized compositor at every complex.
Localization uniqueness on natural transformations [lem-weil-pbc-localization-universal-property] extends the comparison to every derived object.

theorem open_comp_localized
    {A B D : Type v₁} [Category.{h₁} A] [Category.{h₁} B] [Category.{h₁} D]
    [Abelian A] [Abelian B] [Abelian D]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w₁} A] [HasDerivedCategory.{w₁} B]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w₁} D]
    {F : A ⥤ B} {P : B ⥤ A} {G : B ⥤ D} {Q : D ⥤ B}
    {H : A ⥤ D} {T : D ⥤ A}
    [F.Additive] [P.Additive] [G.Additive] [Q.Additive] [H.Additive] [T.Additive]
    [PreservesFiniteLimits F] [PreservesFiniteColimits F]
    [PreservesFiniteLimits P] [PreservesFiniteColimits P]
    [PreservesFiniteLimits G] [PreservesFiniteColimits G]
    [PreservesFiniteLimits Q] [PreservesFiniteColimits Q]
    [PreservesFiniteLimits H] [PreservesFiniteColimits H]
    [PreservesFiniteLimits T] [PreservesFiniteColimits T]
    (a : F ⊣ P) (b : G ⊣ Q) (c : H ⊣ T) (e : Q ⋙ P ≅ T) :
    Adjunction.leftAdjointCompIso (SheafOfModules.OpenTensorNormalization.exactDerivedAdjunction a)
      (SheafOfModules.OpenTensorNormalization.exactDerivedAdjunction b)
      (SheafOfModules.OpenTensorNormalization.exactDerivedAdjunction c)
      (Functor.exactDerivedRestrictionComposition Q P T e) =
        (Functor.mapDerivedCategoryCompIso F G).symm ≪≫
          Functor.mapDerivedCategoryNatIso (Adjunction.leftAdjointCompIso a b c e)
